messages.text: Decided while you were away: landing `5cf7bedd9640`, check green (because the cause is found and fixed: a profile line naming the profile itself now means the extension of that name, other cycles still hit the depth cap; the regression test asserts `ext ls` shows `android: android java`, `ext use android` starts and exits 0, and every shipped profile starts).
